recreation_brief:
1. Create a new PowerPoint slide with light gray background (#f0f0f0).
2. Add title text at top center: 'Bonus Assignment (SVM with Kernels)' in bold red (#c00000), approximately 28-32pt.
3. Add a yellow circle (#ffd700) at top-right corner with black number '39' inside.
4. Draw a large rectangle with thin blue border (#0000ff) spanning most of the slide (roughly 10% from left/right edges, starting below title and ending near bottom).
5. Inside the rectangle, add bullet points in dark blue/navy (#000080) sans-serif font:
   - Bullet 1: 'Develop your own SVM library (from Scratch)'
   - Bullet 2: 'You may use any Quadratic Programming solver (e.g. quadprog, CVXOPT, ..) to solve the Lagrangian Equation.'
   - Bullet 3: 'Make use of Kernel functions (e.g. Quadratic , Polynomial, or RBF)'
   - Bullet 4: 'For each of the given dataset (2-D):'
     - Sub-bullet: 'Draw the dataset points using color coding (assign same color to points belong to same class)'
     - Sub-bullet: 'Divide the background into grid, classify each point in the grid, give each point same color code of the class it belongs to.'
6. Ensure sub-bullets are indented under bullet 4. Use standard round bullet markers.
